# PaymentHsmHardwareOperationAuditLogs

This table contains hardware operations performed on your Azure Payment HSM resource's HSM partitions. It captures Atalla audit logs (ATALLA_LOG_AUDIT), signed system logs (ATALLA_LOG_SIGNED), and certificate chain publish events emitted by the partition service. These logs can be used to monitor events and configure necessary alerts on your Payment HSM resource.
